title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: lodging a notice of loss on a cover
content:
## Situation of use

This entry belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line. It applies when a claimant gives the line written notice of a loss under a cargo cover. A notice of loss is lodged by the claimant in person.

## Registering a notice

1. The desk registers a notice whenever the lodging conditions are met: the claimant is one the product admits, the cover has taken fewer than the product's maximum number of claims (counting claims on the cover that were not withdrawn), and no claim is open on the cover.
2. The desk does not decline such a notice on the ground that the notice will be rejected as soon as it is registered.
3. A notice that fails one of those lodging conditions is not registered at all.
4. The container number, the kind of loss, whether the loss was apparent at delivery, and the packages and weight affected are entered exactly as the claimant states them.

## What the tool does

One call of lodge_cargo_claim_268664bf registers a new claim file under the cover for the named container, with the nature of the loss, whether it was apparent at delivery, the amount entered on the notice and the packages and weight affected. The notice is dated today and the file starts in the notice-registered state. The cover's status becomes the open-claim state. On success the claimant receives the claim reference to quote from then on.

## How it is invoked

lodge_cargo_claim_268664bf is a customer-side tool: it must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves. The desk gives the claimant the cover reference and the customer reference from its lookups.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| cover_id | Cover reference number of the cargo cover the notice is lodged under | Identifier given to the claimant by the desk from the cover lookup |
| customer_id | Customer reference number of the claimant lodging the notice | Identifier given to the claimant by the desk from the customer profile lookup |
| container_number | Number of the container in which the loss occurred | ISO 6346, 4 letters followed by 7 digits, written without spaces, for example AHLU5123450 |
| damage_type | Nature of the loss being notified | One value from the enum below |
| damage_apparent_at_delivery | Whether the loss was visible when the cargo was delivered | true (the loss was apparent at delivery and noted on the delivery receipt) or false (the loss was discovered only after delivery) |
| claimed_amount_usd | Amount entered on the notice as the loss claimed | US dollars, a non-negative number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded half-to-even to 2 decimal places |
| affected_package_count | Number of packages lost or damaged | Whole packages, integer |
| affected_weight_kg | Gross weight of the lost or damaged goods | Kilograms, 1 decimal place; stored rounded to 1 decimal place |

### damage_type values

physical_damage (goods broken, crushed or otherwise physically damaged); wet_damage (goods damaged by water or moisture); temperature_damage (perishable goods damaged by the carrying temperature, such as thawed or warmed cargo); contamination (goods contaminated or tainted); shortage (packages missing from the container); total_loss (the whole container's goods lost); delay_loss (financial loss from late arrival of undamaged goods).

## Return

On success the tool returns: status ("lodged" when the claim file was registered); claim_id (the claim reference of the new file); cover_id; notice_date (the date the notice reached the line, YYYY-MM-DD); outcome (notice_registered); cover_status (claim_open).

## Basis Q&A

**The notice will obviously fail a rejection ground once registered. May the desk refuse to register it?** No. Where the lodging conditions are met, the notice is registered.

**The claimant describes the damage as "crushed cartons". How is the kind of loss entered?** As the claimant states it, using the matching value of the kind-of-loss enum.
